# PowerX Electrical Ltd

## Company Overview
PowerX Electrical Ltd is a licensed and insured electrical contracting company based in Surrey, British Columbia, Canada. We provide 24/7 emergency electrical services, panel upgrades, EV charger installations, residential rewiring, commercial electrical work, fire alarm systems, and backup generator installations across the Lower Mainland (Surrey, Vancouver, Burnaby, Langley, Coquitlam, Delta, White Rock, Maple Ridge, New Westminster, and Pitt Meadows).

## Key Facts
- Licensed Electrical Contractor in British Columbia
- 24/7 Emergency Response (typically 30-60 minutes)
- 8+ years of local experience
- WCB Registered
- Technical Safety BC Compliant
- Google Rating: 4.9/5 (80+ reviews)

## Services
- 24/7 Emergency Electrical Repairs
- Electrical Panel Upgrades (200A service)
- EV Charger Installation (Level 2)
- Whole Home Rewiring & Renovations
- Commercial & Industrial Electrical
- Fire Alarm & Life Safety Systems
- Standby Generator Installation & Maintenance
- LED Lighting & Smart Home Electrical
